People Ops: Last call for privacy & SOC2 training and evidence uploads this week. Deadline: Thursday 11:59pm PT. Please complete the quick attestation and upload any missing artifacts. Links: https://internal.redwood/attest-2026 & https://internal.redwood/forms/comp-upload

Leo R.: Heads up - I have two service accounts that need classification. Do I mark them as 'system' or 'service'?

Security Eng: Mark service accounts as 'service'. If they accept inbound user data, add a note. Use subject prefix CC-3b when uploading related artifacts.

Nina S.: Can we use a console screenshot as interim proof for log retention? Final export will come next week.

People Ops: Yes - screenshot + job id + ticket link is fine as "placeholder: in-progress". Please include ETA in the notes so reviewers know when to expect the final artifact.

compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled - 48 hours left. Manager verification required after your team uploads.

Leo R.: Done attesting, uploaded placeholders for two controls and pinged my manager for verification.

People Ops: Thanks — we'll compile a short risk note for the execs after the window closes. If anything is BLOCKED, tag People Ops and include owner + ETA so we can escalate.
